what_changed: OOD_DEV rebounded 0.584 -> 0.666 (the converged mean); editability 0.955; weight motion very small (<= 0.019).
hypothesis: CONFIRMED: the 2,800 dip was noise around the converged mean (step-2,800 revision), not a trade-off event. The network is in a stationary phase: features, editability and organisation fixed; only held-out behaviour jitters.
evidence: Observation: OOD_DEV returned to 0.666 within one checkpoint (2.2 sd swing); all organisational metrics within their converged bands.
key_question: Anything new expected before the end of training? The learning rate is now decaying (OneCycle), which should shrink the jitter; a falling OOD_DEV variance would support the noise interpretation.
best_experiment: Compare OOD_DEV sd over 3,000-4,500 and 4,500-6,000 with 1,500-2,900 (prediction: decreasing).
intervention_rationale: Stationary phase; no defect addressable by registered primitives.
